question: Xi Jinping out before 2027?
description:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if China's General Secretary of the Communist Party, Xi Jinping, is removed from power for any length of time between July 3, 2025, and December 31, 2026, 11:59 PM ET. Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No".

CCP General Secretary Xi Jinping will be considered removed from power if he announces his resignation from his role as General Secretary, or is otherwise dismissed, detained, disqualified, or otherwise loses his position or is prevented from fulfilling his duties as General Secretary within this market's timeframe.

The primary resolution source for this market will be a consensus of credible reporting.

eventMetadata.context_description: Xi Jinping's firm grip on the Chinese Communist Party, military, and state institutions underpins the 95.5% trader consensus that he will remain in power through 2026. Recent military leadership purges and preparations for the 2027 Party Congress have focused on broad personnel turnover below the top level, with no designated successor or institutional challenge emerging. Speculation around health concerns or elite maneuvering has surfaced periodically but lacks verification and has not altered his dominance. While low-probability scenarios such as acute health events or severe economic shocks could theoretically create openings, the absence of viable alternatives or procedural mechanisms for removal sustains expectations of continuity into the next congress cycle.
